description: Mapping from every raw theme string in output/*.json content_items[].themes_raw to a normalised theme id in themes.json. A null value means the raw string is deliberately not mapped (reason in unmapped_reasons). item_additions lists the few items that received an extra normalised theme because their raw themes alone gave fewer than three. To change the normalisation, edit this file and regenerate themes_normalized: for each item, map its themes_raw in order, drop nulls and duplicates, then append item_additions.

unmapped_reasons.Bangladesh delta: Place name; kept for context in the raw themes only.
unmapped_reasons.Colombia biodiversity: Place name; kept for context in the raw themes only.
unmapped_reasons.drylands: Biome label; the item's other themes cover it.
unmapped_reasons.ecology: Too broad to be useful; the item's other themes cover it.
unmapped_reasons.India: Place name; kept for context in the raw themes only.
unmapped_reasons.island biodiversity: Too broad; the item's other themes cover it.
unmapped_reasons.natural heritage: Too broad; the item's other themes cover it.
unmapped_reasons.ornithology: Discipline label; the item's other themes cover it.
unmapped_reasons.West African timber species: Taxon/place label specific to one case study.
